Why can't non-members of the government be endorsed over 20 times? I'm a little confused...

[quote=wielka_warszawa;60193730]Why can't non-members of the government be endorsed over 20 times? I'm a little confused...[/quote]
Protecting against raids and keeping the delegacy locked to a certain person.

[quote=wielka_warszawa;60193730]Why can't non-members of the government be endorsed over 20 times? I'm a little confused...[/quote]

No one can except the Council (Westmore, Zharvek, and Dabiristan).

Hydronia (President), Arenenge (Vice President), me, Karcov, Joms (all Ministers), etc. have to follow the endocap. It's for security to make invading and destroying the region more difficult.

[quote=skullsbrough;60193748]Protecting against raids and keeping the delegacy locked to a certain person.[/quote]
But think about it, there are currently 90+ WA nations in Cordone. I just don't see the point tbh, especially because we have that many people endorsing most members of gov...

[quote=wielka_warszawa;60193760]But think about it, there are currently 90+ WA nations in Cordone. I just don't see the point tbh, especially because we have that many people endorsing most members of gov...[/quote]
Every region has an endo limit, Cordone isn't unique in that aspect.

[quote=wielka_warszawa;60193760]But think about it, there are currently 90+ WA nations in Cordone. I just don't see the point tbh, especially because we have that many people endorsing most members of gov...[/quote]
1. Cordone's government requires that the delegacy remains locked so no random gets full executive control of the region, that's just how the game works.

2. Cordone is a larger region, meaning that it is at far greater risk by being swamped by several raider regions then just one like you typically see on NS.

[quote=skullsbrough;60193772]1. Cordone's government requires that the delegacy remains locked so no random gets full executive control of the region, that's just how the game works.

2. Cordone is a larger region, meaning that it is at far greater risk by being swamped by several raider regions then just one like you typically see on NS.[/quote]
So then, for example, people don't like the current WA nation, they can't endorse the person they actually want to be the delegate?

[quote=wielka_warszawa;60193782]So then, for example, people don't like the current WA nation, they can't endorse the person they actually want to be the delegate?[/quote]
Given the fact that the WA nation doesn't do much to be disliked, there really is no reason to not like the WA nation. It's really a ceremonial role.

[quote=wielka_warszawa;60193782]So then, for example, people don't like the current WA nation, they can't endorse the person they actually want to be the delegate?[/quote]
Yes. Because that's not how cordone operates. The delegate is ceremonial, but also has executive control game wise.

[quote=wielka_warszawa;60193782]So then, for example, people don't like the current WA nation, they can't endorse the person they actually want to be the delegate?[/quote]
The WA delegate isn't an elected position in this region anyways. It's in the permanent hands of the Council of Cordone.

A pretty good parallel would be constitutional monarchies (albeit the council does not function as a monarchy). You have a Head/s of State (the council) who are not elected and then a Head of Government (the president and his ministers) whom are elected.

[quote=wielka_warszawa;60193760]But think about it, there are currently 90+ WA nations in Cordone. I just don't see the point tbh, especially because we have that many people endorsing most members of gov...[/quote]

It's about influence and endorsement counts.

Endorsement counts are fairly simple. Too many endorsements and you can overthrow the Delegate to destroy the region.

Influence affects whether or not you can eject and ban bad actors. Too much influence because they have too many endorsements and then they can't be ejected and banned.

[quote=dhornaper;60193832]It's about influence and endorsement counts.

Endorsement counts are fairly simple. Too many endorsements and you can overthrow the Delegate to destroy the region.

Influence affects whether or not you can eject and ban bad actors. Too much influence because they have too many endorsements and then they can't be ejected and banned.[/quote]

After some final drafting and finalizing of minor details the trade agreement between [nation]Enkia[/nation] and Nordiheim is ready for its final and binding signature.

[spoiler=[b]Nordiheimian and Enkian Trade Deal of 19th of July 2025[/b]][align=center][b][u]The Beelzebub Deal[/u][/b][/align]

[align=center][b]Trade deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Enkian Theocracy[/b][/align]
[align=center][i]====================================================[/i][/align]

[align=center][i][u]With this deal the two nations of Nordiheim and Enkia agree to adhere to the following points:[/u][/i][/align]
[align=center][i][u]_6__________________________________6____________________________________6_[/u][/i][/align]

[u][b]1.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim agrees to send an anual amount of 800'000 tons of Aluminium from the region of Nordland to Enkia.

[u][b]1.b:[/b][/u] In return Enkia have agreed to provide Nordiheim with an amount of its Natural Gas that is of equal value on anual basis.

[u][b]1.c:[/b][/u] The values will be based on the world market prices and agreed on in 1 year intervalls.

[align=center]++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++[/align]

[u][b]2.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim opens its resource market for Iron and Coal to Enkia for them to buy these resourses with currency of equal value.

[u][b]2.b:[/b][/u] The Value of the Iron and Coal will be based on world market prices that will be agreed on in quarterly intervalls.

[align=center]++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++[/align]

[b][u]3.a:[/u][/b] Both nations markets shall become open to each other for the flow and trade of general goods and services to encourage economic growth and prosperity.

[b][u]3.b:[/u][/b] Neither nation are allowed to place tarifs or special taxes on goods or services from the other nation without both nations coming together to discuss and reach a mutual agreement of understanding and consent.

[align=center]++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++[/align]

[b][u]4:[/u][/b] In the interest of friendship and co-operation Nordiheim declares a willingness to have the trade deal between them and Enkia be open to change and/or new amendments in the future should there be need for it because of changes in either nation or the world scene that have a noticable effect on the original intention of 'The Beelzebub Deal' as long as both parties can arive at a mutual agreement to such changes.

[align=center]++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++[/align]

[align=center][i]Signatory parties[/i][/align]

[align=center][u][i]The Council of The United Regions of Nordiheim[/i][/u]  [color=white]the two nations great signatories[/color]  [u][i]High Priest Malchadorus Fione of The Enkian Theocracy[/i][/u][/align][/spoiler]

Hello guys. I'm making this post to inform you that I possibly might not be able to make a campaign. This is because I have multiple assignments and projects that I want to do in life. I will be normal in terms of activity in every other aspect, but I don't have the time to make a campaign. So instead of that, I will link my first and second campaign from my 1st and 2nd attempts at becoming president, along with some of my goals.

1st run for president:
https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2646757

2nd run for president:
https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2674972

[i]Those two links are my campaign factbooks. Please check them out to find out about some of the things I'm going to do. Keep in mind a lot of the stuff in there is outdated. But I will give you only a few ideas of what I will try to do if I become president.[/i]

[b]  Expand the cordoneballs discord game- Everyone who has discord loves Hydronia's ballsdex game, but I'm willing to expand it and make it more known to our users.

  Organize ministries- The ministries right now seem to be cluttered, and can't work together. I will try to organize them and harmonize the government of Cordone.

  Define roles- Currently, the government has some issues on who has more power than who, or who can do this but not that. I will fix this issue, even though it may seem small now, it will be an issue later on.

  Adding an assistant to some ministers- Currently, Thyven and his ministry are making big changed to Erene. I want to introduce assistants to the ministries in order to help them out.

  Making a court system- In our discord, there is a ticket system where a person calls for help in a situation, mostly for roleplay. This system is one sided, as when a person blames another, the defendent doesn't even know he is being blamed, and can't defend themselves. I aim to bring a fair, and honest trial, with a fair and honest outcome. Of course the ticket system will be there, but if you plan to seek help in a roleplay situation involving an aggressor nation, the court system will be of great help.[/b]
